const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:": "${TOME_LUAJIT:?set TOME_LUAJIT}"; : "${TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT:?set TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT}"; env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" -e '
local files={"mod-tome.lua","tome-ashes-urhrok.lua"}
local function capture(chunk,name)
  local out,sec={},nil
  local old_section,old_t,old_tDef=section,t,tDef
  section=function(s) sec=s end
  t=function(...) out[#out+1]={section=sec,args={...}} end
  tDef=t
  local fn,err=loadstring(chunk,"@"..name); assert(fn,err); assert(pcall(fn))
  section,t,tDef=old_section,old_t,old_tDef
  return out
end
local function readfile(path) local f=assert(io.open(path,"rb")); local s=f:read("*a"); f:close(); return s end
local function gitfile(path) local p=assert(io.popen("git show HEAD:"..path,"r")); local s=p:read("*a"); assert(p:close()); return s end
local changed=0
for _,path in ipairs(files) do
  local base=capture(gitfile(path),"HEAD:"..path)
  local cur=capture(readfile(path),path)
  assert(#base==#cur, path..": record count changed")
  local file_changed=0
  for i=1,#cur do
    assert(base[i].section==cur[i].section, path..": section changed at record "..i)
    assert(#base[i].args==#cur[i].args, path..": arity changed at record "..i)
    for j=1,#cur[i].args do
      if j~=2 then assert(base[i].args[j]==cur[i].args[j], path..": non-target argument changed at record "..i) end
    end
    if base[i].args[2]~=cur[i].args[2] then
      file_changed=file_changed+1; changed=changed+1
      print(string.format("TARGET_CHANGE %s record=%d section=%s source=%s",path,i,tostring(cur[i].section),tostring(cur[i].args[1])))
    end
  end
  print(string.format("LOAD_OK %s records=%d target_changes=%d",path,#cur,file_changed))
